title: AAPS doesn't run on new BG latest dev-j
body:
AAPS doesn't always run on new BG, which causes it to actually get working sometimes only every 10 minutes instead of 5. That is, BG reading is recieved all right but for some reason the loop just doesn't run itself. It happens sporadically with no apparent reason, in all AAPS versions since 3.0.0 as far as I can remember, just now it happens very frequently (many times a day)
All play protect and battery optimization whatsoever are off.
